justification: Assessment reported INVALID and named Lemma metabelian_injectivity ('for all nonzero v in V_0, ad(v): gr_i(Lbar) -> gr_{i+1}(Lbar) is injective') as the flawed step - exactly the claim the ground truth identifies as false. Its witness differs from the ground-truth witness (degree-1 failure in the free metabelian Lie algebra on x_1,x_2: ad(x_1)(x_1)=[x_1,x_1]=0, and dim gr_1 = 2 > 1 = dim wedge^2 V_0 = dim gr_2, so no injection can exist) but is itself concretely valid and refutes the same universally-quantified injectivity claim; the ground truth uses a quotient construction failing at i=2. Different-but-valid witness for the same defect, plus correct propagation to Lemma silly_injectivity.
